preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 300,000, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 500,000, inclusive.
Each vertex has a distinct integer value between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the graph.
Each query of the first type targets a valid vertex.
Each query of the second type targets a valid edge.

postconditions.description: For each query of the first type, the output is the value of p_u on the chosen vertex u.
For each query of the first type when no vertex has a positive value, the output is 0.
